task_fulfillment.rationale: The SOP, reusable form, and tracker substantially address the request, but material corrections are needed: the SOP raises the timeline trigger to >10 days while the source and form specify >2; category selection lacks Scope; and the form imposes PM Lead signoff on Fast-Track despite the authorized PM+QA-only route. Unknown operational details are generally flagged appropriately for finalization. No real change data were provided for a populated request instance. Rendering and human acceptance were not verified.
